verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI355X is a datacenter GPU accelerator. User-configurable autonomous background automations, in the agentic sense, are not a capability axis for a hardware accelerator. The closest evidence is Spur, a first-party Slurm-compatible job scheduler, but it queues compute jobs on cluster infrastructure. Nothing in the pack shows triggers, recurring schedules or autonomous agent automations, so it is adjacent and does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
